messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":11,"verses":[{"chapter":11,"verse":21,"text":"Now then, my children, in keeping these, you will not have the enemy plotting against you nor [evil] intentions in your mind because this is a charm (Phylacterion) from the Lord."},{"chapter":11,"verse":22,"text":"Rise then and gird these around you before I die in order that you may see the angels come at my parting so that you may behold with wonder the powers of God\"."},{"chapter":11,"verse":23,"text":"Then rose the one whose name was Day (Yemima) and girt herself; and immediately she departed her body, as her father had said, and she put on another heart, as if she never cared for earthly things."},{"chapter":11,"verse":24,"text":"And she sang angelic hymns in the voice of angels, and she chanted forth the angelic praise of God while dancing."},{"chapter":11,"verse":25,"text":"Then the other daughter, Kassia by name, put on the girdle, and her heart was transformed, so that she no longer wished for worldly things."}],"book_code":"TJOB"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 21,22,23,24,25 in this chapter.
